params.body:
The first Portal write through the gateway (portal.task, this morning) was refused with `out of schema: no parameter schema is registered for portal.task`: #38 registered the adapter but not the schemas (row 4.1.4), and without a schema an action never reaches the grant.

- `policy/schema.go`: a schema per Portal kind naming exactly the fields Portal's ingest validation accepts; three types added: `number` (hours, amounts), `list` (an update's lines, the stack), `records` (milestones and links: objects of strings).
- `portal.project.patch` takes its fields flat, as the schema names them, instead of one untyped object; `clearNextAction: true` becomes the `nextAction: null` Portal takes.
- Tests: every adapter kind has a schema; well-formed update and patch pass; a key outside the schema is refused.

Belongs in v0.17.0 with #38.
params.title: Portal kinds: a parameter schema per kind
